text: 10月16日，香港交易所宣布，自2026年11月2日起，中国国债将获接纳为香港期货结算有限公司及香港联合交易所期权结算所履行保证金要求的合资格非现金抵押品，有关规则修订已获香港证券及期货事务监察委员会批准。获接纳的债券包括，由中华人民共和国财政部发行，并主要面向国际市场发行的财政部债券；在中国银行间债券市场交易，并由中华人民共和国财政部或政策性银行发行的债券通债券。（中证金牛座）
text_en: On October 16, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing announced that, starting from November 2, 2026, Chinese government bonds will be accepted as eligible non-cash collateral for margin requirements of HKFE Clearing Corporation Limited and The SEHK Options Clearing House Limited, and the relevant rule amendments have been approved by the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission. Accepted bonds include Ministry of Finance bonds issued by the Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China and mainly offered to the international market; and Bond Connect bonds traded in China's interbank bond market and issued by the Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China or policy banks. (Zhongzheng Jinniu Zuo)
